# Scene Relation Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SceneRelationType`](gmeow-SceneRelationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SceneRelationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The spatial or semantic relation in a scene-graph edge — a VALUE vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). leftOf, rightOf, above, below, inside, touching, near, farFrom, sameAs, [`partOf`](../properties/gmeow-partOf.md), holding, wearing, riding, eating, playing are examples; the set is open. Aligns by reference to Visual Genome and OVSR relation strings.
